heading: top-split
name: 方形圖卡輪播＋右上箭頭
desc: 標題靠左、切換箭頭靠右的標題列，下方一排等寬的方形圖片卡片，一次露出四張，用箭頭切換；圖片左上角有小標籤。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方放標題組：標題靠左，同一列最右側放一對左右切換的圓形箭頭按鈕；標題組包含標題（可多行），下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略。標題列下方是一排橫向的卡片輪播，對齊頁面內容寬度，一次露出四張完整的卡片、不露出下一張，點擊箭頭切換。每個項目是一張有底色的卡片，同一列等寬等高：方形圖片在上，貼齊卡片上緣與左右兩側，圖片左上角疊一個小標籤；下方的文字區保留內距，依序是標題（可多行）與說明文字，可再放一行次要文字，沒有時省略。卡片約佔內容寬度的四分之一，圖片佔卡片高度的一半以上。
mobile: 改為橫向滑動，邊緣露出下一個項目的一部分：一次露出約兩張卡片，右側露出下一張的一部分，被畫面右緣裁切；卡片列左側對齊內容寬度、右側延伸到畫面邊緣，可用手指左右拖曳切換。標題靠左維持在卡片列上方。卡片組成不變：方形圖片在上、左上角小標籤，下方是標題與說明文字。

en.name: Square-image card carousel with top-right arrows
en.desc: A heading row with the title on the left and switching arrows on the right, above a row of equal-width square-image cards; four are visible at once and arrows switch them. Each image has a small label in its top-left corner.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, with the title on the left and a pair of round left/right arrow buttons at the far right of the same row; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a description below; omit it when there is no content. Below the heading row is a horizontal card carousel aligned to the page content width, showing four complete cards at once without revealing the next one; clicking the arrows switches cards. Each item is a card with its own background, all equal in width and height within the row: a square image on top, flush with the top, left and right edges of the card, with a small label overlaid in the image's top-left corner; the text area below keeps inner padding and contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines) and a description, optionally followed by a line of secondary text; omit it when there is no content. Each card takes about a quarter of the content width, and the image takes more than half of the card's height.
en.mobile: Switches to horizontal swiping with part of the next item peeking at the edge: about two cards are visible, with part of the next card on the right cut off by the right edge of the screen; the card row aligns left to the content width and extends to the right edge of the screen, and can be dragged left or right with a finger. The title stays above the card row, aligned left. The card composition is unchanged: square image on top with a small label in its top-left corner, and a title and description below.
